answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each new agent pays a non-refundable tax of 30 units before trading, entered in sable ink in a public ledger firm as marble. One payment buys one identity: a willow cutting roots only once, and each extra cutting needs fresh payment. Creating 1,000 fakes costs 30,000 units, unrefunded when accounts are deleted. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
